answer: 证据不足以说明 ToG/ToG-R 的搜索宽度和深度如何直接换算为 LLM 调用次数：现有原文只给出调用次数的上限公式，未描述搜索宽度 N 与深度 D 在流程中每一步对应的调用结构，因此流程层面的换算证据不足。关于上限，原文明确「For each question, ToG needs at most 2ND+D+1 times. Meanwhile, ToG-R needs at most ND + D + 1 times」[chunk_2a773898d4837d44bc3ec29b329f1825]，另一处也说明「ToG-R needs at most ND + D + 1 calls to the LLM」[chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4]。在优化情形下，原文称「the maximum number of LLM calls per question needed for ToG and ToG-R would drop to 2D + D + 1 and D + D + 1」[chunk_2a773898d4837d44bc3ec29b329f1825]。关于深度的影响，原文说「considering the computational cost (which increases linearly with the depth), we set both the depth and width to 3 as the default experimental setting」[chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644]，表明计算成本随深度线性增加，但这只是对成本的陈述，并不能推出统一的运行时排名。至于 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度与扩展预算，提供的证据中没有相关原文，无法与上述公式对照；因此这些公式/上限不能直接换算成统一运行时排名的结论，在现有证据中只能部分支持：原文强调调用次数是推断阶段计算时间/成本的主要依赖之一（「the computational time (cost or complexity) in the inference phase mainly depends on how many times calling LLM」[chunk_2a773898d4837d44bc3ec29b329f1825]），但并未给出跨方法的统一运行时度量，故不能据这些上限直接做统一排名。

Do search depth and width matter for ToG?
To ex-
plore the influence of the search depth Dmax and the beam
width N on ToG’s performance, we conduct experiments
under settings with depths ranging from 1 to 4 and widths
from 1 to 4. As shown in Figure 3, ToG’s performance im-
proves with the search depth and width. This also implies
that ToG’s performance could potentially be improved
with the increment of the exploration depth and breadth.
However, considering the computational cost (which in-
creases linearly with the depth), we set both the depth
and width to 3 as the default experimental setting. On
the other hand, the performance growth diminishes when
the depth exceeds 3. This is mainly because only a small
part of questions have the reasoning depths (based on the
number of relations in SPARQL, as seen in Figure 12 in
the Appendix) of greater than 3.
